Rashi on Chagigah 5b:1:1.hebrew: אינו מהן - מזרע ישראל, דכתיב "והסתרתי פני מהם" (דברים ל״א:י״ז), שצועק מצרות הבאות עליו ואינו נענה שלא יבואו:
Rashi on Chagigah 5b:1:1.english: He is not from them - I.e., from the seed of Israel, as it is written: "And I will hide My face from them" (Deuteronomy 31:17), for he cries out over the troubles that come upon him and is not answered, that they should not come.

Rashi on Chagigah 5b:1:2.hebrew: והיה לאכול - שהעובדי כוכבים שוללין ממונו:
Rashi on Chagigah 5b:1:2.english: “And they shall be devoured” - For the idolaters plunder his money.

Rashi on Chagigah 5b:1:3.english: And they seized him - They plundered him.

Rashi on Chagigah 5b:2:1.hebrew: בחלום אדבר בו - "ביום ההוא" קא דייק: ביום, ולא בלילה, שמראין לו חלום כדי שיתפלל על הדבר:
Rashi on Chagigah 5b:2:1.english: “In a dream I speak with him” - [The verse says] “in that day,” which is precise: [it means] by day, and not at night, that they show him a dream so that he will pray about the matter.

Rashi on Chagigah 5b:2:2.english: His hand is outstretched - to protect him.

Rashi on Chagigah 5b:3:1.hebrew: אפיקורסים - שאינם מאמינים לדברי רז"ל, כגון צדוקים:
Rashi on Chagigah 5b:3:1.english: Epicureans [heretics] - Those who do not believe the words of our Sages, of blessed memory, such as the Sadducees.

Rashi on Chagigah 5b:3:2.hebrew: אחוי ליה - על ידי סימן רמז לו, החזיר פניו:
Rashi on Chagigah 5b:3:2.english: He gestured to him - By means of a sign, he hinted to him that [the Master] had turned His face [away].

Rashi on Chagigah 5b:4:1.english: With a gesture - By a hint.

Rashi on Chagigah 5b:5:1.hebrew: נסרחה חכמתם - באדום כתיב: ״האין עוד חכמה בתימן? אבדה עצה מבנים״ והכוונה מישראל:
Rashi on Chagigah 5b:5:1.english: Their wisdom has vanished - With regard to Edom it is written: “Is wisdom no more in Teiman? Has counsel perished from the prudent?” [This means] from Israel.

Tosafot on Chagigah 5b:1:1.hebrew: שדור בי שבור מלכא וגרבוהו - אומר הר"י: דהיינו ההוא דבפרק בתרא דברכות (דף נו.) גבי פשריה דבר הדיא, שפתר לו שתמות אשתו ויאבד כל אשר לו מאת המלך:
Tosafot on Chagigah 5b:1:1.english: "Those of the house of King Shapur sent and plundered him" - The Rabbi Yitzchak says: This is the same incident as that in the last chapter of Berakhot (56a), concerning the interpretation of Bar Hedya, who interpreted for him [a dream, meaning] that his wife would die and that he would lose everything he had to the king:
